\begin{array}{l} \mathsf{cons}(W_1 \sqcup W_2) \iff {} \\ \qquad \mathsf{cons}\,W_1 \land \mathsf{cons}\,W_2 \land \mathsf{cons}(W_1|_S \sqcup W_2|_S),\ {\color{cTy}S} = A_1 \cap A_2 \end{array}

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@t-lf-counters\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{lp{0.45\linewidth}}
$\displaystyle o : {\color{cTy}S}_x^{\lfadd{a,m}} \Rightarrow a \leq f(o) \leq m$ & an end type ${\color{cTy}S}_x^{\lfadd{a,m}}$ has its point in the subscript, its credit $a$ and its tickets $m$ in the superscript, and its counter $f$ lies between the two \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\color{cTy}S}_x^{\lfadd{a}},\ ({\color{cTy}T} \mathrel{\tymultimap } {\color{cTy}U})^{\lfadd{a}}$ & a lower bound on the counter of an end, or of the ends a closure captured \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\color{cTm}e} : {\color{cTy}T}\ !\ c$ & the term performs at most $c$ actions before it returns \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\lenv} - c$ & what is held while ${\color{cTm}e}$ runs loses $c$, and each credit must be at least $c$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \tyc{Skip}_x^{\lfadd{a}} - c$ & an idle end loses credit without the check \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\color{cTy}S}_x^{\lfadd{a,m}},\ a \leq m$ & an upper bound on the counter, the value an action resets it to \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\color{cTy}S}_{x^{+}}^{\lfadd{m,m}}$ & an action returns its end with credit $m$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{tk}(o) + \mathsf{tk}(\overline{o}) \leq N$ & the two ends of a channel have at most $N$ tickets together \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\color{cTy}T}' - 1 \leq {\color{cTy}T}[x\cdot i]$ & a sent end loses one \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle ({\color{cTy}T} \mathrel{\tymultimap } {\color{cTy}U})^{\lfadd{a}} : {\lenv} - a$ & the body of a closure is typed with each captured end at its credit minus $a$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle a_1 + m_2 > N,\ a_2 + m_1 > N$ & after a link the new dual end of a waiting end has a lower counter than the old one \\[0.5ex]
\end{tabular}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@t-lf-wf\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{lp{0.45\linewidth}}
$\displaystyle \varrho : \mathsf{Point} \to \mathsf{Ord}$ & a ranked world orders its points by ordinals \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{gen\_new}\,{\cGamma}\,\rho\,C$ & E-New at a fresh base asks that the new tree can be ranked \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{ranked}\,W$ & process typing at a finite bound asks a ranked world \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \varrho(x)$ & lock-free adequacy ranks a thread waiting on an end at $x$ by $\varrho(x)$ \\[0.5ex]
\end{tabular}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@block@t-agecap\endcsname{\begin{array}{c}\begin{array}{c}\dfrac{\begin{array}{c}\mathsf{tfree}\,{\color{cTy}T}\end{array}}{{\color{cTy}T} - c = {\color{cTy}T}}\;\textsf{Lower-Free} \qquad \dfrac{\begin{array}{c}c \leq a\end{array}}{{\color{cTy}S}_x^{\lfadd{a}} - c = {\color{cTy}S}_x^{a - c}}\;\textsf{Lower-Credit} \\[2ex] \dfrac{\begin{array}{c}\mathsf{idle}\,{\color{cTy}S}\end{array}}{{\color{cTy}S}_x^{\lfadd{a}} - c = {\color{cTy}S}_x^{\lfadd{\max(a - c, 0)}}}\;\textsf{Lower-Idle} \qquad \dfrac{\begin{array}{c}c \leq a\end{array}}{({\color{cTy}T} \mathrel{\tymultimap } {\color{cTy}U})^{\lfadd{a}} - c = ({\color{cTy}T} \mathrel{\tymultimap } {\color{cTy}U})^{a - c}}\;\textsf{Lower-Arr} \\[2ex] ({\color{cTy}T}_1 \tyotimes  {\color{cTy}T}_2) - c = ({\color{cTy}T}_1 - c) \tyotimes  ({\color{cTy}T}_2 - c) \qquad ({\color{cTy}T}_1 \tyoplus  {\color{cTy}T}_2) - c = ({\color{cTy}T}_1 - c) \tyoplus  ({\color{cTy}T}_2 - c) \qquad (\tyexists^{l}\bar\iota.\,C.\,{\color{cTy}T}) - c = \tyexists^{l}\bar\iota.\,C.\,({\color{cTy}T} - c)\end{array}\end{array}}%

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@block@r-ex\endcsname{\begin{array}{c}\dfrac{\begin{array}{c}{\cGamma} \mathrel{\vdash_W} C[\bar x]\quad {l \preccurlyeq {{\color{cTy}T}[\bar x]}}\quad {{\cGamma}, C \mathrel{\vdash_W} l \preccurlyeq {\color{cTy}T}}\quad {\cGamma} ; {\lenv} \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : {\color{cTy}T}[\bar x]\lfadd{\ !\ \varepsilon}\end{array}}{{\cGamma} ; {\lenv} \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : \tyexists^{l}\bar\iota.\,C.\,{\color{cTy}T}\lfadd{\ !\ \varepsilon}}\;\textsf{E-Pack} \\[2ex] \dfrac{\begin{array}{c}{\lenv}(i) = \tyexists^{l}\bar\iota.\,C.\,{\color{cTy}T},\ \neg{\mathsf{unlimited}}\,{\color{cTy}T}\quad {\bar\iota \mathrel{\#} {\cGamma}, {\lenv}, F}\quad {\mathsf{conserv}_{{\cGamma}}(\bar\iota, C)}\quad {{\cGamma}, C(\bar\iota) ; {\lenv}[i \mapsto {\color{cTy}T}] \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : {\color{cTy}U}\lfadd{\ !\ \varepsilon}}\end{array}}{{\cGamma} ; {\lenv} \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : {\color{cTy}U}\lfadd{\ !\ \varepsilon}}\;\textsf{E-Open} \\[2ex] \mathsf{tree}(\bar\iota) = \{x \mid \mathsf{base}(x) \in \bar\iota\} \\[2ex] \mathsf{conserv}_{{\cGamma}}(\bar\iota, C) \iff \forall z, y \notin \mathsf{tree}(\bar\iota).\ {\cGamma}, C(\bar\iota) \mathrel{\vdash} z \prec y \Rightarrow {\cGamma} \mathrel{\vdash_W} z \prec y\end{array}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@blockdf@r-ex\endcsname{\begin{array}{c}\dfrac{\begin{array}{c}{\cGamma} \mathrel{\vdash_W} C[\bar x]\quad {l \preccurlyeq {{\color{cTy}T}[\bar x]}}\quad {{\cGamma}, C \mathrel{\vdash_W} l \preccurlyeq {\color{cTy}T}}\quad {\cGamma} ; {\lenv} \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : {\color{cTy}T}[\bar x]\end{array}}{{\cGamma} ; {\lenv} \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : \tyexists^{l}\bar\iota.\,C.\,{\color{cTy}T}}\;\textsf{E-Pack} \\[2ex] \dfrac{\begin{array}{c}{\lenv}(i) = \tyexists^{l}\bar\iota.\,C.\,{\color{cTy}T},\ \neg{\mathsf{unlimited}}\,{\color{cTy}T}\quad {\bar\iota \mathrel{\#} {\cGamma}, {\lenv}, F}\quad {\mathsf{conserv}_{{\cGamma}}(\bar\iota, C)}\quad {{\cGamma}, C(\bar\iota) ; {\lenv}[i \mapsto {\color{cTy}T}] \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : {\color{cTy}U}}\end{array}}{{\cGamma} ; {\lenv} \mathrel{\vdash}^{F} {\color{cTm}e} : {\color{cTy}U}}\;\textsf{E-Open} \\[2ex] \mathsf{tree}(\bar\iota) = \{x \mid \mathsf{base}(x) \in \bar\iota\} \\[2ex] \mathsf{conserv}_{{\cGamma}}(\bar\iota, C) \iff \forall z, y \notin \mathsf{tree}(\bar\iota).\ {\cGamma}, C(\bar\iota) \mathrel{\vdash} z \prec y \Rightarrow {\cGamma} \mathrel{\vdash_W} z \prec y\end{array}}%

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@block@t-consts\endcsname{\begin{array}{lll}
\kw{send} & : {\color{cTy}T}[x\cdot i] \tyotimes  {{\color{cTy}S}_x} \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} {{\color{cTy}S}'}_{x^{+}} & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = {!}(\bar\iota.\,{\color{cTy}T}).{\color{cTy}S}',\ \mathsf{pscoped}\,\bar\iota\,{\color{cTy}T},\ x \prec {\color{cTy}T}[x\cdot i] \\
\kw{recv} & : {\color{cTy}S}_x \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} {\color{cTy}T}[x\cdot i] \tyotimes  {{{\color{cTy}S}'}_{x}^{+}} & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = {?}(\bar\iota.\,{\color{cTy}T}).{\color{cTy}S}',\ \mathsf{pscoped}\,\bar\iota\,{\color{cTy}T} \\
\kw{close} & : {\color{cTy}S}_x \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} \ast & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = \tyc{Close} \\
\kw{select}_i & : {\color{cTy}S}_x \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} (\mathsf{if}\ i\ \mathsf{then}\ {\color{cTy}S}''\ \mathsf{else}\ {\color{cTy}S}')_{\overline{x\cdot\kappa_i}} & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = \tyoplus ({\color{cTy}S}',{\color{cTy}S}'') \\
\kw{branch} & : {\color{cTy}S}_x \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} {{\color{cTy}S}'}_{x\cdot{\kappa_{\mathsf{false}}}} \tyoplus  {{\color{cTy}S}''}_{x\cdot{\kappa_{\mathsf{true}}}} & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = \&({\color{cTy}S}',{\color{cTy}S}'') \\
\kw{link} & : {\color{cTy}S}_x \tyotimes  {\overline{{\color{cTy}S}}_{\overline{x}}} \mathrel{\tymultimap } \ast & \\
\kw{spawn} & : (\ast \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{u}_{l} \ast) \mathrel{\tymultimap } \ast & \\
\kw{force} & : \tyBox(\tyforall \bar\iota\,\bar {\tvar}.\ C.\ \ast\mathrel{\tymultimap }^{u} {\color{cTy}U}) \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{u[\bar x]} {\color{cTy}U}[\bar s][\bar x] & {\cGamma} \mathrel{\vdash} C[\bar x]
\end{array}}%
\expandafter\gdef\csname map@blockdf@t-consts\endcsname{\begin{array}{lll}
\kw{send} & : {\color{cTy}T}[x\cdot i] \tyotimes  {{\color{cTy}S}_x} \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} {{\color{cTy}S}'}_{x^{+}} & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = {!}(\bar\iota.\,{\color{cTy}T}).{\color{cTy}S}',\ \mathsf{pscoped}\,\bar\iota\,{\color{cTy}T},\ x \prec {\color{cTy}T}[x\cdot i] \\

\kw{close} & : {\color{cTy}S}_x \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} \ast & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = \tyc{Close} \\
\kw{select}_i & : {\color{cTy}S}_x \mathrel{\tymultimap }^{x} (\mathsf{if}\ i\ \mathsf{then}\ {\color{cTy}S}''\ \mathsf{else}\ {\color{cTy}S}')_{\overline{x\cdot\kappa_i}} & \mathsf{unfold}({\color{cTy}S}) = \tyoplus ({\color{cTy}S}',{\color{cTy}S}'') \\

\expandafter\gdef\csname map@table@sr-reading\endcsname{\begin{tabular}{lp{0.45\linewidth}}
$\displaystyle {\color{cTm}v} \in V^{W}_{\beta}\llbracket {\cTheta} \vdash {\color{cTy}T} \rrbracket$ & the value ${\color{cTm}v}$ owns exactly the ends ${\cTheta}$ and is safe at ${\color{cTy}T}$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\color{cTm}e} \in E^{W}_{\beta}\llbracket {\cTheta} \vdash {\color{cTy}T} \rrbracket^{F}$ & the term ${\color{cTm}e}$, holding ${\cTheta}$, is safe until it returns a value of ${\color{cTy}T}$, its context acting at $F$ afterwards \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle p \in P^{W}_{\beta}\llbracket {\senv} \vdash {\color{cTy}T} \rrbracket$ & the process $p$ is safe with interface ${\senv}$ \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle \mathsf{Obl}_\ell({\color{cTm}e}')$ & what a step ${\color{cTm}e} \xrightarrow{\ell} {\color{cTm}e}'$ must preserve \\[0.5ex]
$\displaystyle {\color{cTm}e}'\ \mathsf{at}\ {\cTheta}'$ & ${\color{cTm}e}'$ is safe holding ${\cTheta}'$, at the same index after a free step and at each $\gamma$ with $\gamma + c \leq \beta$ after a step of cost $c$ \\[0.5ex]
\lfadd{$\displaystyle {\color{cTm}e} \in F^{N}_{\beta}\llbracket {\cPhi} \vdash \sigma\ !\ d \rrbracket$} & the thread ${\color{cTm}e}$, holding ${\cPhi}$ with counters and tickets, keeps its counters at index $\beta$ \\[0.5ex]
\lfadd{$\displaystyle a \in S^{N,W}_{\beta}\llbracket {\senv} \vdash {\color{cTy}T} \rrbracket$} & each thread of $a$ is in $E[\kappa_L]$ and in the counter relation, under one ownership map \\[0.5ex]
\end{tabular}}%

\mathsf{ready}_W({\cTheta} \mid F, t) & \iff & \mathsf{stable}\,t \Rightarrow {({\cTheta}|_{\mathsf{offered}\,t} = \varnothing \Rightarrow t \in \mathsf{Val})} \land (\kw{link}\,t \lor {{\cTheta}|_{\mathsf{offered}\,t} \prec_W \overline{{\cTheta} \setminus {\mathsf{offered}\,t}} \cup {F}}) \\[1.5ex]
\mathsf{ready}_W({\senv}, p) & \iff & \mathsf{stable}\,p \Rightarrow {\kw{link}\,p} \lor \big(({\senv}|_{\mathsf{offered}\,p} = \varnothing \Rightarrow {\mathsf{terminated}}\,p) \land {\forall y \in \overline{{\senv} \setminus {\mathsf{offered}\,p}}.\ \exists x \in {\senv}|_{\mathsf{offered}\,p}.\ W \vdash x \prec y}\big)

\quad {(\mathsf{step})\ \forall \ell, {\color{cTm}e}'.\ {\color{cTm}e} \xrightarrow{\ell} {\color{cTm}e}' \Rightarrow {\mathsf{Fobl}_{\ell}({\color{cTm}e}')}} \\[6pt]

{\cPhi} : \mathsf{End} \rightharpoonup \mathsf{STy} \times \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N},\quad {\cPhi}(o) = {\color{cTy}S}^{f,m} \\[6pt]
\mathsf{fsem}\,N\,{\cPhi}\,{\color{cTm}e} \iff \forall \beta.\ {\color{cTm}e} \in {F^{N}_{\beta}\llbracket {\cPhi} \vdash {\mathsf{thread}}\ !\ \infty \rrbracket}

{\cPhi}{\downarrow} & = & \{o \mapsto {\color{cTy}S}^{f \mathbin{\dot-} 1,\,m} \mid o \mapsto {\color{cTy}S}^{f,m} \in {\cPhi}\} \\
\mathsf{idle}\,{\color{cTy}S} & \iff & \mathsf{unfold}\,{\color{cTy}S} = \tyc{Skip}
